description: This file defines the FavoritesController class for managing favorite records in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods to create, remove, check, and retrieve favorite items, interacting with the Favorites bean and handling AJAX requests.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller class that manages user favorites in SuiteCRM, providing actions to create, delete, check, and fetch favorite items for the current user.

methods.name: action_create_record
methods.description: Creates a new favorite record based on request parameters and current user context, then returns the new favorite's ID.

methods.name: action_remove_record
methods.description: Removes a favorite record identified by request parameters if it exists, returning success or failure as JSON.

methods.name: action_check_favorite
methods.description: Checks if a specified record is marked as favorite for the current user, returning the favorite ID or false.

methods.name: action_get_sidebar_elements
methods.description: Retrieves current user's sidebar favorites for a given record ID.
